Mashajo
Kaliningrad, Russia11765 contributions

Cozy place with delicious French cuisine
Aug 2025 • Solo
Saw this restaurant by accident while walking - initially headed elsewhere, but decided to stop here. The interior is very pleasant: bookcases, wooden tables, greenery - a cozy and peaceful atmosphere is created. There were few visitors, so you can have a comfortable time. The menu features French cuisine, with slightly above average prices. I ordered a duck breast with potatoes in the village way. The dish was cooked for about 20 minutes. The pitch was beautiful, everything looked delicious. The meat was tender and juicy, and the sauce complemented the taste well. The service is attentive and friendly. All in all, a great place for a quiet dinner with a good kitchen.

🌟 Charming, Cozy & Delicious – A Must-Visit! 🌟

Le Comptoir Bistro & Books is a hidden gem in Saigon. Just steps from Nguyen Hue Street, this cozy spot blends French charm with Vietnamese warmth. The food is simple yet flavorful — from duck confit to fresh seafood — all beautifully presented. The atmosphere is perfect for a quiet dinner, a coffee break, or a chat with friends. Friendly service and great vibes make it a place you’ll want to return to. Highly recommended!
